avoid_supplements.name: Calcium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Chelation of risedronate in GI tract reduces bioavailability by up to 60%; must separate dosing
avoid_supplements.action: Administer risedronate on empty stomach; separate calcium by at least 30 minutes before or 2 hours after risedronate

avoid_supplements.name: Iron supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Divalent cation binds risedronate, significantly reducing absorption
avoid_supplements.action: Separate dosing by at least 30 minutes; administer risedronate first on empty stomach

avoid_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Divalent cation chelation decreases risedronate bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Maintain minimum 30-minute separation; take risedronate on completely empty stomach

avoid_supplements.name: Zinc supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Divalent cation binds risedronate, reducing GI absorption
avoid_supplements.action: Separate by at least 2 hours from risedronate administration

avoid_supplements.name: Aluminum-containing antacids
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Trivalent aluminum cation forms insoluble complex with bisphosphonate
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or separate by minimum 30 minutes after risedronate dosing

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May enhance bone mineralization effects; generally beneficial but monitor calcium-phosphate balance
caution_supplements.action: Monitor serum calcium and phosphate; coordinate timing with calcium supplementation

avoid_foods.name: High-calcium dairy products
avoid_foods.mechanism: Dietary calcium chelates risedronate in GI lumen, reducing bioavailability by 50-60%
avoid_foods.action: Do not consume milk, cheese, or yogurt within 30 minutes before or 2 hours after risedronate dose

avoid_foods.name: Fortified food products (calcium-fortified juices, cereals)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Significant calcium content impairs risedronate absorption
avoid_foods.action: Avoid consuming fortified foods during risedronate absorption window (30 min before to 2 hours after)

caution_foods.name: Iron-rich foods (red meat, spinach, fortified cereals)
caution_foods.mechanism: Dietary iron may modestly reduce risedronate absorption; effect less pronounced than supplements
caution_foods.action: No strict avoidance required, but optimal absorption achieved on empty stomach without iron-rich foods

monitoring_notes: Risedronate requires strict administration on empty stomach with plain water only, 30 minutes before any food, supplements, or other medications to ensure adequate bioavailability. Monitor for esophageal irritation, hypocalcemia, and renal function during long-term therapy; ensure adequate dietary calcium intake outside the absorption window.
